ops.body:
Merge and deploy (Recommended)
Question: Merge captain-hook #362 now? It is green on its final head (21 checks) and current with main. Merging starts the automatic Captain Hook release, and I then switch only the Captain Hook service on this host with the guarded procedure Lanes B and C used. Two judgment calls ride on it: reuse is on by default, and one review finding rated a blocker is documented rather than fixed (an extension file replaced in place while an owner is starting can mislabel that owner's facts; release installs are not exposed).
Options: Merge and deploy (Recommended) | Merge, reuse off by default | Hold for a build identity | Merge only, no switch
